title: Uncle's brass band caps from the Excelsior band
summary: Dutre recalls a keepsake of band caps from the Excelsior brass band, lost when his grandmother found them.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: No, I never did see Honoré or Peter. But, I do know that he played in a lot of the top brass bands like that. Yeah. I think it was Excelsior one band he played with before he left there. Yeah, I didn't even know. Because I had all the caps, he left me all the caps at the house. Well, he had the old caps.
I saved them until my grandmother discovered them.

That's too bad he didn't save them, it'd be good for a museum or something. No, that's for sure. A lot of those old caps, people never see them again now. They have the names, I guess, on them. Yeah, they have the names.

They had three different caps. They had the regular film cap and they had the other cap with a white cap and they had another cap with a white band around it. I didn't know what that was for. As I was to now, I know they only carried two caps but he had three.
